name: Finland's Cyber Security Strategy 2024–2035
owner: National Cyber Security Centre Finland (NCSC-FI) / Security Committee (Turvallisuuskomitea)
description: Finland's Cyber Security Strategy 2024–2035 (Government Resolution VNK/2024/135 of October 10, 2024). National cybersecurity strategy adopted by the Finnish Government under the Comprehensive Security (Kokonaisturvallisuus) model, coordinated by the Security Committee (Turvallisuuskomitea) and the Prime Minister's Office.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber Security Centre Finland (NCSC-FI) / Security Committee (Turvallisuuskomitea) (ncsc.fi) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for National Cyber Security Centre Finland (NCSC-FI) / Security Committee (Turvallisuuskomitea) (ncsc.fi).
